The #Delhi Traffic Police on Monday issued a traffic advisory ahead of a demolition drive at and around Faiz-E-Ilahi Mosque (Dargah Faiz-E-Ilahi) in the Ramlila Maidan area. The restrictions and diversions will come into effect from 8.00 am on Tuesday, and remain in place until the operation is completed.

Police said traffic movement in and around Ramlila Maidan and adjoining roads is likely to be affected due to the demolition of what has been termed unauthorised construction. Commuters have been advised to avoid the affected stretches, follow diversions and plan their journeys in advance.

"Why Arc? Because while others struggle with volatility and slow speeds, Arc delivers sub-second finality and stable gas fees. It’s the only blockchain built from the ground up to connect programmable money with the real-world global economy."

Let's explore the highlights of the @arc 👇

Project Arc: The Economic Operating System for the Internet

Project Arc is an open Layer-1 blockchain platform designed to bridge the gap between "programmable money" and real-world economic activity.
Developed by Circle Internet Group (the creators of the USDC stablecoin), Arc is described as the "Economic OS for the Internet." Its mission is to build an open, transparent financial infrastructure that makes moving money as easy and fast as sending an email.

History and Development

Announced in August 2025, Arc launched its public testnet on October 28, 2025. This project is a major strategic move for Circle, a company that has raised over $2.2 billion and leads the stablecoin market with USDC.

Circle’s CEO, Jeremy Allaire, envisions Arc as a foundational layer for core financial processes like payments, foreign exchange (FX), and capital markets. Key milestones include:

> Massive Partnership Network: Arc was built in collaboration with over 100 partners, including giants like Visa, Mastercard, BlackRock, AWS, Coinbase, and Deutsche Bank.

> Current Status: As of January 2026, the project is in a rigorous testnet phase, using "chaos-testing" tools (Quake, Guzzler, Spammer) to ensure the network stays stable under high traffic.

> Mainnet Launch: Expected later in 2026.

Core Features of Arc

Arc is engineered to solve the limitations of traditional blockchains (like high volatility and slow speeds) by focusing on three pillars: speed, stability, and compliance.

> Sub-Second Speed: Transactions are finalized in less than one second (approx. 500ms block times) using the Malachite consensus engine.

> Stablecoin-Native Gas: Unlike other blockchains where fees fluctuate based on a volatile token (like ETH or SOL), Arc uses USDC or EURC for gas fees. This makes costs predictable for businesses.

> Configurable Privacy: Organizations can choose their level of privacy to meet regulatory requirements while still benefiting from blockchain transparency.

> EVM Compatibility: Developers can use familiar Ethereum tools to build apps on Arc without needing to learn a new programming language.

> Deep Circle Integration: The network natively supports Circle’s suite of tools, including CCTP (Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol) and programmable wallets for instant global transfers.

Real-World Use Cases

Arc isn't just for crypto enthusiasts; it’s built for the global economy:

1. Global Payments & FX: It supports 24/7 instant settlement. Through StableFX, users can swap stablecoins (like USDC to EURC) instantly without waiting days for traditional bank settlements.

2. Capital Markets: Facilitates institutional-grade DeFi, including tokenized assets and lending protocols, backed by partners like BlackRock.

3. AI & Agentic Commerce: Arc provides the financial rails for AI agents to conduct autonomous business transactions.

4. National Stablecoins: The testnet already features stablecoins for countries like Japan, Brazil, Canada, and the Philippines, moving toward a truly on-chain global economy.

Current Status and Community

Project Arc is currently open for public testing. Developers and users can:

> Claim faucet tokens and deploy smart contracts.

> Interact with dApps like ArcFlowFinance (for swaps and liquidity).

> Apply for the Arc Builders Fund, which provides capital and mentorship to new projects.

The project has already gained industry recognition, receiving nominations for awards like Best RWA (Real World Asset) / Privacy Chain for 2025/2026.

 👉Project Arc represents a massive leap in integrating blockchain into the global economy. By focusing on predictable fees, sub-second speed, and regulatory compliance, Circle is positioning Arc to be the primary "Operating System" for the future of digital finance. 
As we approach the 2026 mainnet launch, Arc is inviting everyone—from independent developers to global banks—to help build the new internet economy.

@ArcFlowFinance
